findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_image, generate_sound_effect, check_generation_status, get_generation_history, upload_media, create_social_post · Private data: generate_video, generate_sound_effect, upscale_image, upscale_video, upload_media · Public sink: generate_video, generate_music, generate_sound_effect, upscale_image, upscale_video, check_generation_status, upload_media, create_social_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_image, generate_sound_effect, check_generation_status, get_generation_history, upload_media, create_social_post · Private data: generate_video, generate_sound_effect, upscale_image, upscale_video, upload_media · Public sink: generate_video, generate_music, generate_sound_effect, upscale_image, upscale_video, check_generation_status, upload_media, create_social_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
